summary_own_words: Save is partitioned, not one blob: one savedata block per subsystem, plus save control, save-outside-field, delete-save and game-clear-save handling. A save table record carries sizes, offsets and a footer size. Stored records use reversible data-scrambling helpers (not audio). Block sizes, formats and checksums are owed, not decided here.
